QuestInfo.name: [Home] A Gift from Mom and Dad
QuestInfo.0: Maestra Fiametta at the Commerci Trade Center seems to be quite familiar with Alvin and Amy's parents. Maestra Fiametta asked you to wait while she collected a gift left by their parents.
QuestInfo.1:
By the time you arrived, Alvin and Amy's parents had already left the Commerci Trade Center, but it seems they left a gift and letter behind for the twins. Amy was clearly upset, but acted as if nothing was wrong.

Amy and Alvin are probably tired from their travels. You should head back home.
QuestInfo.2:
